evidence: Wallet label and changes to src/wallet/spend.cpp, feebumper.cpp, and coincontrol.h modifying locktime generation during fee bumps
rationale: Fixes an anti-fee-sniping fingerprinting bug where RBF replacements can receive an nLockTime older than the transaction they replace. While privacy of transaction creation and fingerprinting are explicit priorities in the wallet category, the issue affects a small fraction of transactions ('less than 2% of all the transactions that have been replaced', ~200-300 per week), making this a worthwhile fix that is reasonably deferrable.
